selection_policy: Three known policy episodes used only to test data plumbing; purposive, outcome-aware exploratory selection, not an unbiased event census. No adverse-event or no-event claims.

events.title: 证券交易印花税自8月28日起减半征收
events.source_excerpt: 自2023年8月28日起，证券交易印花税实施减半征收。财政部 税务总局 2023年8月27日
events.timing_note: Sunday announcement; next-session research anchor, not an executable fill price. Simultaneous policy package is one cluster; other components not yet catalogued.

events.title: 1月24日宣布2月5日降准0.5个百分点
events.source_excerpt: 潘功胜1月24日宣布，中国人民银行将于2月5日下调存款准备金率0.5个百分点，向市场提供长期流动性约1万亿元。来源：新华社；网页时间2024-01-25。
events.timing_note: Conservative availability uses next session after retrieved dated government republication. Actual announcement was Jan24; do not interpret Jan26 as economic event time. Timing must be improved before daily event inference.

events.title: 9月24日金融支持经济高质量发展发布会
events.source_excerpt: 国务院新闻办公室于2024年9月24日（星期二）上午9时举行新闻发布会。网页发布时间2024-09-24 18:51。
events.timing_note: Briefing starts 09:00 but individual announcement times are not encoded. Use next-session availability of retrieved transcript, not 09:00 for entire package. effective_at denotes briefing date, not uniform policy implementation; components have different implementation dates.
